result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly with a coherent layout. A few minor visual defects were found, mostly related to truncated or clipped content at screen edges. No critical breakage detected.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the text look cut off rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or platform equivalent) so truncated names end with '…', or reduce font size / allow two lines for restaurant names.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge with only a tiny sliver visible, giving no hint of its label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so partially visible chips show enough of the label to indicate scrollability, or add a fade gradient at the edge.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the search placeholder use light gray on white, which may fall below WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.

issues.description: Delivery time badges on the food cards ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit over busy imagery; on the light poké card the white pill has low separation from the pale background.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the time badges to ensure they remain distinct on light images.
